# Create Icon

Source: [wiki article 6071](../archive/6071.md); edited 2025-05-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create Icon](../../api/actions/create-icon.md).

<a id="wiki-6071-n1"></a>

- Icons persist until destroyed, use Last Created Entity, and can fail at entity capacity.

<a id="wiki-6071-n2"></a>

- Player-valued positions put icons above the player's head; Show When Offscreen controls visibility even behind the viewer.

<a id="wiki-6071-n3"></a>

- Team icon colors are red/blue according to viewer hostility.
